scope: Read-only mapping review; no API/browser/resource/Run activity. Canonical repair source is feature-inventory.json.

case_reviews.expected_text: Task/Script Revision 在 Execution 中固定记录。
case_reviews.product_contract: PRODUCT.md §29 lists Task Revision and Script Revision among the Execution's一期记录; it does not require a separate Script Revision UI label.
coverage: A real Script Task was read back at Task revision 1 and Script revision 2 before execution.
The matching SUCCESS Execution API row records task_revision=1 and script_revision=2 with the same Task/Script IDs.
After exact Task and Script deletion, a readback still shows that same Execution SUCCESS with both revisions 1/2; Task/Script definitions were verified absent.
remaining: Execution detail UI shows Task revision but not Script revision. This is not a missing Product §29 contract field: the API Execution stores it, while the same UI detail provides result feedback. Do not make UI display an extra acceptance requirement from the title alone.

case_reviews.expected_text: command/script/application 三类任务实际运行结果；适用用户操作、Hub/Agent实际效果与UI反馈一致。

covered.basis: Owned Task ledger says type=command. The one real UI-confirmed Execution has API PENDING, then same-detail UI PENDING→RUNNING→SUCCESS and matching Execution ID/Task/Node; no second Run.
One actual UI confirm produced one matching API Run and SUCCESS detail; Script Task revision 1/Script revision 2 and output/environment oracles are recorded. This covers the Script slice only.

A real Application deploy Execution reached SUCCESS, physical deployment state/health was checked, and the Application UI showed SUCCESS history. The caller evidence is a helper POST to /api/applications/{id}/deploy, not a user UI Run of an app_deploy Task; it does not establish the full user-triggered Task path.

remaining: For full P11-05 user-path coverage, a genuine app_deploy Task execution initiated from the applicable UI must be distinguished from the existing direct Application deploy endpoint path. The old four-type roundtrip evidence records app_deploy/app_operation definitions but its execution field is null; it cannot fill this gap.
Do not count TLS readonly/Go-probe Command executions as an Application Task. The saved TLS task execution snapshots are helper command runs, not an app_deploy execution.

limitations: The P11-05 canonical record remains NOT_RUN until Root maps the verified command/script slices and decides whether the existing API-triggered Application deploy plus UI history satisfies the applicable user-action dimension; this review recommends PARTIAL because an app_deploy Task UI invocation is not evidenced.
No TLS Go probe was treated as an ApplicationTask substitute.
